item.title: Hiring Plans Show Promise for Biopharma Job Seekers: BioSpace Report
item.description: More biopharma organizations were actively recruiting at the end of 2025 than 2024, based on the new BioSpace employment outlook report. Areas in demand this year include research and development and clinical. Organizations are also prioritizing artificial intelligence hires.

item.title: 10 Companies Hiring IT Professionals Now
item.description: Looking for an IT job? From data engineer to information security, check out the BioSpace list of 10 companies hiring life sciences professionals like you.

item.title: 3 Top Challenges Facing Regulatory Professionals Right Now
item.description: Regulatory challenges have been even more top of mind than usual given recent upheaval at the FDA. BioSpace spoke to three industry experts about key issues, which include applying new artificial intelligence guidance. The experts also shared advice for working with regulators.

item.title: Employers Warm Up to Remote Workers Again: BioSpace Report
item.description: Biopharmas are less focused on local job candidates and are more open to recruiting regardless of location, according to the new BioSpace employment outlook report. Even employers who prefer to hire locally would consider remote hires for some roles.

item.title: The Top 12 Companies Hiring in Biopharma Now
item.description: Looking for a biopharma job? Check out the BioSpace list of 12 top companies hiring life sciences professionals like you.

item.title: Webinar: 2026 Hiring Trends and Job Market Signals
item.description: This webinar provides a clear-eyed assessment of current hiring conditions across biopharma, exploring which roles and skills are in demand, where opportunities are emerging, and how hiring practices are evolving.

item.title: 9 Companies Hiring in Boston
item.description: Looking for a biopharma job in Boston? Check out the BioSpace list of nine companies hiring life sciences professionals like you.

item.title: Hiring Outlook: January Brings Year-Over-Year Layoff Decline
item.description: Last month, biopharmas let go or projected they would let go of less than 500 people combined, based on BioSpace estimates, down almost 1,000 from January 2025. Still, competition for open jobs remains strong, with employed and unemployed biotech and pharma professionals eyeing their next roles.

item.title: 7 Key Insights Into the 2026 Job Market and Hiring Landscape
item.description: Biopharma professionals need to understand today’s job market and how they can stand out to position themselves for success. Three talent acquisition and recruiting experts discussed these topics in a BioSpace webinar, from the importance of contract work to the value of an advocate.

item.description: Follow along as BioSpace tracks job cuts and restructuring initiatives.
